instructions: Reserve complete physical trials before fitting. Identify contact datum and depth knots externally. max_condition_number is a numerical rejection threshold, not a physical parameter. Each trial: id, split (fit/validation), provenance (physical/synthetic), conditions_id, relative NDJSON path. Each row: t_s, depth_m (positive into engagement), depth_rate_m_s, force_z_N (bias/gravity corrected force on upper brick along local M +Z), phase (insertion/withdrawal/dwell). fit_axial.py writes predicted_force_z_N evaluated at the SAME observed kinematics for evaluate_traces.py. Force replay alone does not validate policy, capture/jamming, rate-independent hysteresis, dynamic transfer or retention. Do not populate missing measurements with synthetic values.
